consent.v1.body:
Namaste! I'm Dawai Saathi 💊 I help you understand prescriptions and lab reports.

Before we start:
• I save the photos you send, the medicine details I read from them, and your reminders.
• Photos are deleted automatically after {{retention_days}} days.
• I am not a doctor and I never diagnose. Always check with your doctor or pharmacist.
• Send DELETE any time to erase all your data.

Privacy policy: {{privacy_url}}

Do you agree?
consent.v1.accepted_welcome:
Thank you! 🙏 You can now:
📷 Send a photo of a prescription or lab report
💊 Send MEDS to see your medicines
❓ Send HELP to see all commands

I only explain what is written. Please confirm everything with your doctor or pharmacist.
consent.v1.declined: Okay, no problem. I will not read or save any of your documents. Whenever you change your mind, just send any message and I will ask again.
consent.v1.reminder: To read your documents I first need your permission. Nothing you sent has been opened or saved. Please choose an option below.
help.body:
I'm Dawai Saathi 💊

I can:
• Read a prescription photo and explain it simply
• Explain a lab report (never a diagnosis)
• Suggest cheaper generics with the same salt

Commands:
HELP – this message
MEDS – your active medicines
LANGUAGE – change language
STOP REMINDERS / START REMINDERS
DELETE – erase all your data

🚨 Emergency? Call 112 or 108.

I am not a doctor. Always ask your doctor or pharmacist before changing anything.
reminders.disabled: Dose reminders are switched off. Send START REMINDERS to turn them on again.
meds.none: You have no active medicines saved yet. Send a photo of your prescription to add them.
delete.confirm_question:
⚠️ This will permanently delete ALL your data: messages, photos, medicines and reminders. It cannot be undone.

Delete everything?
delete.expired: That confirmation has expired, so nothing was deleted. Send DELETE again if you still want to erase your data.
delete.done: Done. All your data has been deleted. If you message me again we will start fresh. Take care! 🙏
emergency.general: 🚨 This sounds like an emergency. Please call 112 (or 108 for an ambulance) right now or go to the nearest hospital. Do not wait for a reply here: I am not a doctor and cannot help in an emergency.
emergency.self_harm: 💛 I'm really sorry you are going through this. You are not alone. Please call Tele-MANAS (free, 24x7) on 14416 now. If you are in immediate danger, call 112 or 108 or go to the nearest hospital.
common.next_step: What would you like to do next?
rx.wrong_ack: Thank you for telling me. I marked this prescription as "needs checking" and will not use its medicines for reminders. Please show the prescription to your pharmacist, or type the correct details here.
rx.reminders_soon: Dose reminders are coming soon. Your medicines are saved: send MEDS to see them.
rx.generic_unavailable: I don't have generic suggestions saved for this prescription. Please send the photo again to check, or ask your pharmacist about cheaper options with the same salt.
rx.not_found: I could not find that prescription any more. Please send the photo again.
